title: Not All Information Is Worth Asking For: Decision-Informed Information Seeking with LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2610.32181v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to support decisions under incomplete information, where deciding what to look up and when to stop matters as much as the final answer. However, LLMs fall into an information trap: They pay for checks, i.e., costly pieces of evidence, that cannot change their decision or are not worth their cost, and they keep asking when the evidence is already sufficient. To this end, we propose Decision-Informed Value-of-information Acquisition (DIVA), a simple yet effective procedure for LLM information seeking based on the decision value of evidence. DIVA 1) lets the LLM specify a small decision model, i.e., how likely a bad outcome is and how each check would shift this probability, through short numeric questions and 2) values each candidate check by how much its imagined outcomes improve the decision net of its cost, stopping when no check is worth its cost. Its variant, DIVA-U, further accounts

translated_title: 并非所有信息都值得询问：基于决策感知的大语言模型信息获取
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用于在不完整信息下支持决策，在这种情况下，决定查询什么以及何时停止与最终答案同样重要。然而，LLM会陷入信息陷阱：它们会为那些无法改变决策或不值得其成本的检查（即昂贵的证据片段）付费，并且在证据已经充分的情况下仍然继续询问。为此，我们提出了决策感知的信息价值获取方法（Decision-Informed Value-of-information Acquisition，DIVA），这是一种基于证据决策价值的简单而有效的LLM信息获取程序。DIVA 1）让LLM通过简短的数值问题指定一个小型决策模型，即坏结果发生的可能性有多大，以及每项检查将如何改变这一概率；2）通过设想各候选检查的潜在结果能在扣除成本后对决策带来多大改善来评估每项候选检查的价值，当没有检查值得其成本时即停止。其变体DIVA-U进一步考虑了……
tldr: 提出DIVA方法，让大语言模型基于证据的决策价值扣除成本后来评估每项检查是否值得进行，从而决定该查询什么信息以及何时停止，避免为无法改变决策或不值得的信息付费。
en_tdlr: Proposes DIVA, a simple yet effective procedure that enables LLMs to decide what information to acquire and when to stop by evaluating each check's value based on how much its imagined outcomes improve the decision net of its cost, avoiding paying for information that cannot change the decision.
